treatmentJourney.title: Initial Consultation and 3D Scan
treatmentJourney.description: We perform a comprehensive evaluation of your oral health and use advanced diagnostics to plan your precise implant placement.

treatmentJourney.title: Preparation and Foundation Work
treatmentJourney.description: Any necessary extractions or preparatory treatments are completed to ensure a healthy environment for your new implants.

treatmentJourney.title: Precise Surgical Placement
treatmentJourney.description: Using delicate techniques and excellent pain management, the titanium implant is professionally placed into the jawbone.

treatmentJourney.title: Healing and Osseointegration
treatmentJourney.description: Over several months, the implant bonds securely with your natural bone, creating a rock-solid foundation for your new teeth.

treatmentJourney.title: Abutment and Final Impressions
treatmentJourney.description: Once healed, we attach the connector and take detailed impressions to craft your custom-fitted permanent restoration.

treatmentJourney.title: Delivery of Permanent Smile
treatmentJourney.description: We fit your final crown or bridge, ensuring a perfect look and comfortable bite so you can walk out with a contented smile.

faqItems.question: How long does the dental implant process take?
faqItems.answer: The journey typically involves phases; after the initial placement, a healing period of about three months allows the implants to bond with the bone before final crowns.

faqItems.question: Am I a candidate for implants if I have had bone loss?
faqItems.answer: We specialize in advanced diagnostics and restorative dentistry to evaluate and prepare patients for successful permanent teeth implants even after tooth loss.

faqItems.question: Is the dental implant procedure painful?
faqItems.answer: Our patients consistently praise our excellent pain management and delicate technique, ensuring a comfortable experience from injection to final fitting.

faqItems.question: What is the benefit of an implant over a bridge?
faqItems.answer: Implants offer a permanent, stable solution that functions like natural teeth without requiring the reduction of neighboring healthy teeth.

faqItems.question: Do you offer emergency dental services?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we encourage you to contact us for urgent care, which is usually provided the same day to address immediate dental problems.

faqItems.question: How do I schedule a consultation for full mouth rehab?
faqItems.answer: You can contact our Rancho Bernardo office via phone at (858) 676-1845 or email to set up your comprehensive assessment.

doctor.name: Sandhya Ramanujam
doctor.bio: Dr. Sandhya Ramanujam is a highly trained dental professional with nearly three decades of experience, serving San Diego residents since 1995. She holds a Master's in Psychology and is a Certified Clinical Hypnotherapist and NLP Coach, allowing her to offer a unique, calming dental experience. Known as 'Dr. Delicate' by her patients, she specializes in advanced restorative procedures and permanent dental implants. Her philosophy unifies the mind and body to provide holistic, pain-free dental care.
